ad_library.summary: 3 ad IDs were opened directly on 2026-11-21 and all three returned an active ad on the Eagle Solar Systems page (page ID 1462508363606856, facebook.com/61595903925834): 2327283458060008 (21 Nov), 1123693900270768 (19 Nov) and 1677382683817329 (7 Nov). The page's own listing reported ~2 results in the same session, so treat the count as approximately 2-3 live ads with three creatives confirmed. Two are in Telugu and one in English, all sell the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy, and all three click to a Facebook lead form. There is no website for this business, so no site audit was run.

funnel.destination: Facebook lead form (FB.ME) - 'Book now' on all 3 ads
funnel.meaning: There is no website and no landing page anywhere in the funnel: every click ends in a Facebook lead form. Enquiries live in the Meta inbox, nothing can be retargeted, and there is no page a buyer can check the firm on before handing over a phone number.

findings: There is no website at all. None of the three ads carries a site link and every click ends in a Facebook lead form ('Book now'), so all enquiry data sits inside Meta and nothing can be retargeted, scored or followed up outside the inbox.
The 19 Nov Telugu ad opens with 'Raitanna' - the word for a farmer - on a residential rooftop offer for homeowners, so the first word of the ad excludes most of the audience it is paying to reach.

All three ads make the same promise ('up to Rs.78,000', 'save up to 90%' with an asterisk) and none of them states a system size, a price, an EMI or a warranty - a homeowner has nothing to compare and nothing to act on except calling.
The 21 Nov English ad says 'Choose Eagle Solar System' (singular) against 'Eagle Solar Systems' everywhere else - the brand name is wrong in the headline of the newest ad.

The company is on Telangana's TGREDCO empanelled-supplier list (Sy.No-142/A/1, Mallampet, Bachupally, Maheshwaram, Medchal-Malkajgiri 502303) - a government credential that appears nowhere in any ad, in a market where every competitor claims subsidy help.
There is no page anywhere to verify the business: a buyer searching the name finds a Facebook page and third-party directory listings, on a purchase that runs to lakhs.
next_steps: Put up one landing page - before the next ad

A single page with the Rs.78,000 slab, one worked price, the TGREDCO empanelment, your address, and an enquiry form with the Meta Pixel. That single page is what makes every future rupee measurable and retargetable.
Replace the farmer-opener with a homeowner version
The farmer salutation 'Raitanna' opens a home rooftop ad. The Telugu copy should open with the homeowner's bill, the way the 7 Nov ad does.
Put one number in the creative
A system size and a price or EMI (even '3 kW from Rs.X, EMI Rs.Y') will out-perform 'up to Rs.78,000' on its own, because every competitor is already saying 'up to Rs.78,000'.
It is the strongest trust asset the business owns and it is currently used in none of the ads. Put it in the creative and on the landing page, with the supplier list reference.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
